links.comparator_used: single LLMs and LLM ensembles (AI output alone), and also single physicians and physician collectives
links.outcome: accuracy of open-ended differential diagnosis on text-based case vignettes
links.effect: Hybrid collectives of physicians and LLMs outperformed single LLMs and LLM ensembles; the abstract gives no numeric effect sizes. The result held across medical specialties and levels of professional experience.
links.quote: We show that hybrid collectives of physicians and LLMs outperform both single physicians and physician collectives, as well as single LLMs and LLM ensembles.

design_hint: hybrid human-LLM collective diagnosis (clinician review/combination of LLM outputs)
